name: Buscador de normativa técnica oficial

evidence_levels.document_hit: Literal text found in an official source. It is evidence, not an applicability conclusion.
evidence_levels.reviewed_rule: Structured rule linked to an exact source fingerprint and reviewed for the stated scope.
evidence_levels.deterministic_result: Calculation or validation produced by a versioned engine using reviewed rules.

result_contract.notice: A trustworthy answer must expose its evidence level, source, locator, applicability scope and review status.

update_workflow.notification: A GitHub issue identifies the changed source and affected tools.
update_workflow.change_control: Official documents and indexes can refresh automatically. A semantic change blocks dependent reviewed rules until human validation.

licensing: Official public texts are stored. UNE and IEC standards are referenced by designation only unless licensed distribution rights exist.
